2607.11444.title: UMoE:Unlocking Every Expert in Domain-Specific Training
2607.11444.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity without proportional compute cost and have become a key architecture for frontier large language models (LLMs). Yet domain-specific post-training inherits an expert pool shaped by mixed-domain pre-training: a substantial subset of experts contributes little on the target domain, and standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leaves the composition of this pool unchanged. We propose a simple, budget-preserving pipeline that realigns the expert pool to the target domain before fine-tuning. Given a target domain, we (1) prune the experts with lowest domain-aligned saliency, (2) regrow the expert pool to its original size through perturbation-based expert expansion, and (3) apply standard SFT. The resulting model preserves the original expert count, parameter count, and inference cost. With a single frozen recipe and no per-domain hyperparameter tuning, UMoE consistently improves over direct sft across two MoE architectures (Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), five domains (math, code, science, tool-use, and agentic coding), and 12 benchmarks. Representative improvements are 3.4 points in math average accuracy, 6.0 points on SWE-bench Verified. On a strong in-house math corpus, direct sft already surpasses Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (82.81 vs.\ 81.06), yet UMoE further raises the average to 84.17, an additional 1.36 points, demonstrating robustness to a substantially stronger SFT regime. Data-scaling experiments further show that the gain persists as training data grows. Analysis reveals that the direct-SFT model allocates substantial routed-expert compute to a low-saliency subset that can be removed post hoc with little average degradation; UMoE turns this redundant capacity into useful domain capacity and achieves lower training loss, with gains spanning all difficulty levels in downstream evaluation.
2607.11444.paper_summary_zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型在不成比例的計算成本下擴展容量，並已成為前沿大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的關鍵架構。<lb/>然而，特定領域的後訓練繼承了一個由混合領域預訓練塑造的專家池：一個相當大的專家子集對目標領域貢獻甚微，而標準的監督微調 (SFT) 使這個池的組成保持不變。<lb/>我們提出了一個簡單且節省預算的流程，在微調之前將專家池重新對齊到目標領域。<lb/>給定一個目標領域，我們 (1) 剪除最低領域對齊顯著性的專家，(2) 通過基於擾動的專家擴展將專家池重新增長到其原始大小，(3) 應用標準 SFT。<lb/>結果模型保持了原始的專家數量、參數數量和推理成本。<lb/>使用單一的固定配方且不進行每個領域的超參數調整，UMoE 在兩個 MoE 架構 (Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B)、五個領域 (數學、代碼、科學、工具使用和代理編碼) 以及 12 個基準測試中持續改善了直接 SFT 的表現。<lb/>代表性的改善包括數學平均準確率提高 3.4 分，在 SWE-bench Verified 上提高 6.0 分。<lb/>在一個強大的內部數學語料庫上，直接 SFT 已經超越了 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (82.81 對 81.06)，而 UMoE 進一步將平均提高到 84.17，額外增加 1.36 分，顯示出對更強 SFT 環境的穩健性。<lb/>數據擴展實驗進一步顯示，隨著訓練數據的增長，增益持續存在。<lb/>分析顯示，直接 SFT 模型將大量路由專家的計算分配給一個低顯著性子集，這個子集可以在事後被移除而不會造成太大平均降級；UMoE 將這些冗餘容量轉化為有用的領域容量，並實現了更低的訓練損失，增益遍及下游評估中的所有難度級別。
